201711240.title: File:Aral Sea Moynaq Karakalpakstan Uzbekistan September 2025 Ph Khusen Rustamov- 03.jpg

ImageDescription.value:
The ship graveyard in Moynaq, Karakalpakstan, Uzbekistan, photographed in September 2025. Abandoned fishing vessels rest on the former seabed of the Aral Sea, bearing witness to one of the world’s most severe environmental disasters. Once a thriving fishing port, Moynaq was left far from the receding shoreline as the sea shrank due to large-scale river diversion for irrigation, particularly for cotton production during the Soviet era. Today, the rusting ships serve as a reminder of the environmental consequences of human activity and the profound changes that have affected local communities and their traditional way of life.
Photo by Khusen Rustamov.
